premises.text: Mobile users everywhere complain about signal, quality, and price
premises.evidence_span: people pay too much for their mobile phone service

premises.text: TextFree lets users send free, unlimited text messages
premises.evidence_span: TextFree lets you send free, unlimited text messages

premises.text: Real mobile phone numbers handed to users turn iPod touches and iPads into communication platforms
premises.evidence_span: we started handing out phone numbers, real mobile phone numbers to all of our users

premises.text: TextFree with voice is a full SIP-based VoIP client that turns an iPod Touch or iPad into a phone with free calls
premises.evidence_span: Text-free with voice is a full-on SIP-based voice over IP client. It turns your iPod Touch, iPad into a phone, lets you make free phone calls

premises.text: The minute bank lets users buy minutes through iTunes or earn them by downloading offered apps
premises.evidence_span: it lets me either buy minutes. You can buy them with your iTunes gift card. You can buy them with your iTunes account. Or you can earn minutes

premises.text: Over Wi-Fi's big pipe, a better codec delivers HD quality audio
premises.evidence_span: over Wi-Fi, because it's a big, big pipe, we can use a nice codec to give you HD quality audio

premises.text: The offer flywheel pays Pinger: users get free minutes, companies get downloads and chart position
premises.evidence_span: user gets free minutes. The company gets the download, and they go up in the iTunes charts, and we get paid

premises.text: Brands pay to reach young users who are making their first brand decisions
premises.evidence_span: brands want to connect with our users because our users are making brand decisions for the first times in their lives

domains.name: Free texting and VoIP calling product

value.text: Customers can literally never pay for very high quality phone service
value.evidence_span: our customers could literally never pay for a very, very high quality phone service that gives them unlimited texting and unlimited talking

secondary_value.text: Make texting, and now talking, free for everyone
secondary_value.evidence_span: we want to make texting, and now today, talking, free

causal_links.evidence_span: pay too much for their mobile phone service
lets you make free phone calls
